rationale: Source: T0 19.09, WS +7.694 (max_ss, reg-to-reg), C0 11.3963, so R1 11.40 leaves only 3.7 ps over the source's own critical path. IO budgets scale with period and stay >=1.5 ns positive at R1; hold is reg-to-reg and period-independent; DRV (0 vs bar 295) and DRC have headroom. ABC's tt-based delay target is non-binding at both clocks, so the netlist is likely unchanged, but timing-driven placement weights (IO vs reg-to-reg ranking) and newly active post-CTS/post-GRT repair_timing (~25 ps margin) perturb the layout. Outcome hinges on layout noise (~±0.1 ns at max_ss) versus repair benefit, and on whether GRT estimates are optimistic versus RCX (routed wire +14% over estimate hints yes). Near coin-flip with slight lean to pass; slope ~0. If R1 fails, a step-back at >=11.45 probably passes; most likely kept clock 11.40.
